    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₁] [Fintype ι₂] [DecidableEq ι₂]
    (ψ : QuantumState (ι₁ × ι₂))
    (X Y M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₁)
    (T : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₂)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ * M * Y) T)) ^ 2 ≤
      ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ * M * X) T) * ev ψ (opTensor (Yᴴ * M * Y) T) := by sorry
preamble_opens: open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
docstring:
Bipartite-tensor Cauchy–Schwarz for state expectations.

For PSD operators `M`, `T` and arbitrary operators `X`, `Y`,
`(ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ M Y) T))² ≤ ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ M X) T) *
ev ψ (opTensor (Yᴴ M Y) T)`.

The proof factors `M = √M · √M`, `T = √T · √T` (continuous functional calculus
square roots) and applies `ev_cauchy_schwarz` to
`opTensor (√M · X) √T` and `opTensor (√M · Y) √T`.

theorem PMF.realWeightedSum_uniformOfFintype_comm {α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module MIPStarRE.LDT.Error M]
    (f : α → β → M) :
    realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype α)
        (fun a => realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype β) (fun b => f a b)) =
      realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype β)
        (fun b => realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) (fun a => f a b)) := by sorry

/-!
# Uniform PMF finite-expectation identities

This module contains high-level uniform-expectation identities for Mathlib
probability mass functions.  The statements are phrased in terms of
`PMF.realWeightedSum`, rather than finite sums, so that product,
marginalization, equivalence-transport, and finite push-forward arguments can
be carried out directly in the probability-mass-function language.
